name: TRP Catalog Enquiry Forms and Lead Logs for WooCommerce
author: techrahulpal

sections.description:
TRP Catalog Enquiry Forms and Lead Logs for WooCommerce is a lightweight, responsive, and secure WooCommerce plugin that replaces the default WooCommerce purchase flow with flexible product enquiries.

Perfect for wholesale stores, custom manufacturing, quotation-based selling, or catalog display, the plugin enables custom “Enquiry on Mail” and “WhatsApp Now” triggers.

Key Features

  • Selectable Catalog Mode: Select product categories where purchasing (Add to Cart / Buy Now) is hidden and replaced automatically with enquiry buttons.
  • Custom Form Builder: Drag, drop, reorder, and configure custom input fields (Name, Email, Phone, Numbers, Checkboxes, Textareas) for the popup modal.
  • Dual Channel Engagement: Support both direct email submissions (using secure wp_mail) and redirect to WhatsApp Web / Mobile App with pre-filled message text.
  • Google Sheets Real-time Integration: Send logged enquiries to your Google Spreadsheet instantly via asynchronous webhooks.
  • Local Leads Logging Dashboard: View and search collected leads inside WordPress, monitor delivery metrics, and download filtered monthly reports as CSV files.
  • Highly Customizable: Edit buttons colors, background gradients, custom font families, borders, and margins directly from the settings page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the trp-catalog-enquiry-lead-logs folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the ZIP file via Plugins > Add New > Upload.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Product Enquiry to customize your settings, forms, and triggers.
sections.faq:
Does it support variable WooCommerce products?

Yes! Hiding cart elements is handled via theme-safe classes, which means variation attributes (like size or color) remain completely active, allowing customers to choose their specs before requesting enquiries.

Can I use it on specific products only?

Yes. You can use the shortcodes [trpcell_enquiry_buttons] or [trpcell_enquiry_form] on any specific product page, or use the Category Catalog Mode to enable/disable checkout automatically per category.

How do I sync lead logs with Google Sheets?

Under the Google Sheets Sync tab in the plugin settings page, we provide a 7-step guide along with the copy-paste Apps Script code block. Enable the webhook and paste the Web App URL to begin syncing in real-time.
